name: Banco Central: The Governor Dilemma
description: Simulation where participants act as the governor of the Banco Central de Quisqueda, a fictional Latin American central bank. Teams set the policy rate, choose forward guidance tone, and respond to economic shocks across 8 quarters to bring inflation to target while maintaining output stability and central bank credibility.

this.NEUTRAL_RATE = 1.5; this.WORLD_RATE = 5.0; this.NATURAL_UNEMPLOYMENT = 6.0; this.POTENTIAL_GROWTH = 2.0; this.ROUNDS = [ { quarter: 'Q1Y1', supplyShock: 0, demandShock: 0, fxShock: 0, hasShockPanel: false, hasFxPanel: false, hasFiscalPanel: false, briefingKey: 'briefing_r1' }, { quarter: 'Q2Y1', supplyShock: 0, demandShock: 0, fxShock: 0, hasShockPanel: false, hasFxPanel: false, hasFiscalPanel: false, briefingKey: 'briefing_r2' }, { quarter: 'Q3Y1', supplyShock: 1.5, demandShock: -0.3, fxShock: 1.0, hasShockPanel: true, hasFxPanel: false, hasFiscalPanel: false, briefingKey: 'briefing_r3' }, { quarter: 'Q4Y1', supplyShock: 0.3, demandShock: -0.4, fxShock: 0, hasShockPanel: false, hasFxPanel: false, hasFiscalPanel: false, briefingKey: 'briefing_r4' }, { quarter: 'Q1Y2', supplyShock: 0, demandShock: -0.3, fxShock: 0, hasShockPanel: false, hasFxPanel: true, hasFiscalPanel: false, briefingKey: 'briefing_r5' }, { quarter: 'Q2Y2', supplyShock: 0, demandShock: 0.2, fxShock: 0, hasShockPanel: false, hasFxPanel: false, hasFiscalPanel: true, briefingKey: 'briefing_r6' }, { quarter: 'Q3Y2', supplyShock: 0, demandShock: 0, fxShock: 0, hasShockPanel: false, hasFxPanel: false, hasFiscalPanel: false, briefingKey: 'briefing_r7' }, { quarter: 'Q4Y2', supplyShock: 0, demandShock: 0, fxShock: 0, hasShockPanel: false, hasFxPanel: false, hasFiscalPanel: false, briefingKey: 'briefing_r8' } ]; } initialize(state) { if (!state.domainState || Object.keys(state.domainState).length === 0) { state.domainState = { policyRate: 6.50, inflation: 6.8, gdpGrowth: 3.1, outputGap: 1.5, prevOutputGap: 1.2, exchangeRate: 8.40, exchangeDepreciation: 0, credibilityIndex: 68, reserves: 22.0, unemployment: 5.4, lastGuidance: null, lastRateDirection: 0, capitulated: false, inflationHistory: [], rateHistory: [], credibilityHistory: [], gdpHistory: [], outputGapHistory: [], exchangeHistory: [], reservesHistory: [] }; } if (!state.decisions || Object.keys(state.decisions).length === 0) { state.decisions = { rateChange: 0, guidanceTone: 'neutral', shockResponse: 'lookthrough', fxIntervention: 'none', fiscalResponse: 'independence' }; } this._updateBriefing(state); } validateDecisions(decisions) { var rateInput = document.getElementById('rateChangeInput'); if (rateInput) decisions.rateChange = parseInt(rateInput.value); var guidanceInput = document.getElementById('guidanceInput'); if (guidanceInput) decisions.guidanceTone = guidanceInput.value; var shockInput = document.getElementById('shockResponseInput'); if (shockInput) decisions.shockResponse = shockInput.value; var fxInput = document.getElementById('fxInput'); if (fxInput) decisions.fxIntervention = fxInput.value; var fiscalInput = document.getElementById('fiscalInput'); if (fiscalInput) decisions.fiscalResponse = fiscalInput.value; return true; } calculateResults(state) { var d = state.decisions; var ds = state.domainState; var period = state.currentPeriod; var roundIdx = Math.min(period - 1, this.ROUNDS.length - 1); var round = this.ROUNDS[roundIdx]; var rateChangeBps = d.rateChange || 0; var newRate = ds.policyRate + (rateChangeBps / 100); newRate = Math.round(newRate * 100) / 100; var ci = ds.credibilityIndex; var beta = 0.15 + (ci / 100) * 0.45; var alpha = 1.0 - beta; var guidanceEffect = 0; if (d.guidanceTone === 'hawkish') guidanceEffect = -0.3; if (d.guidanceTone === 'dovish') guidanceEffect = 0.3; var realRate = newRate - ds.inflation; var rateGap = realRate - this.NEUTRAL_RATE; var prevGap = ds.outputGap; var demandShock = round.demandShock || 0; var newGap = 0.7 * prevGap - 0.2 * rateGap + demandShock; var supplyShock = round.supplyShock || 0; if (round.hasShockPanel) { if (d.shockResponse === 'partial') { supplyShock = supplyShock * 0.65; newGap -= 0.2; } else if (d.shockResponse === 'full') { supplyShock = supplyShock * 0.35; newGap -= 0.5; } } var fxShock = round.fxShock || 0; if (round.hasFxPanel) { var ciFxMultiplier = ci > 50 ? 1.0 : (ci > 40 ? 1.5 : 2.2); fxShock = 8.0 * ciFxMultiplier / 8.0; if (d.fxIntervention === 'sterilized') { fxShock = fxShock * 0.5; } else if (d.fxIntervention === 'ratedefense') { fxShock = fxShock * 0.3; newRate += 0.5; newGap -= 0.4; } else if (d.fxIntervention === 'combined') { fxShock = fxShock * 0.2; newRate += 0.25; newGap -= 0.2; } } if (round.hasFiscalPanel) { if (d.fiscalResponse === 'capitulation') { newRate -= 0.5; newGap += 0.3; } else if (d.fiscalResponse === 'diplomatic') { newGap += 0.1; } } var exchangePassthrough = ds.exchangeDepreciation * 0.15; var expectedInflation = this.INFLATION_TARGET + guidanceEffect * (1.0 - ci / 100.0); var newInflation = alpha * ds.inflation + beta * expectedInflation + 0.25 * ds.prevOutputGap + exchangePassthrough + supplyShock; newInflation = Math.max(0.5, newInflation); newInflation = Math.round(newInflation * 10) / 10; newGap = Math.round(newGap * 10) / 10; var rateDiff = newRate - this.WORLD_RATE; var riskPremium = Math.max(0, (50 - ci) * 0.12); var exchangeChange = -0.4 * rateDiff + riskPremium + fxShock; var reserveChange = 0; if (d.fxIntervention === 'sterilized') reserveChange = -1.5; if (d.fxIntervention === 'combined') reserveChange = -1.0; var newExchangeRate = ds.exchangeRate * (1 + exchangeChange / 100); newExchangeRate = Math.round(newExchangeRate * 100) / 100; var newReserves = ds.reserves + reserveChange; newReserves = Math.round(newReserves * 10) / 10; var newGdpGrowth = this.POTENTIAL_GROWTH + (newGap - prevGap) + 0.3 * newGap; newGdpGrowth = Math.round(newGdpGrowth * 10) / 10; var newUnemployment = this.NATURAL_UNEMPLOYMENT - 0.5 * newGap; newUnemployment = Math.max(3.0, Math.round(newUnemployment * 10) / 10); var ciChange = 0; var inflGap = Math.abs(newInflation - this.INFLATION_TARGET); var prevInflGap = Math.abs(ds.inflation - this.INFLATION_TARGET); if (inflGap < prevInflGap) { ciChange += 3 + Math.min(5, (prevInflGap - inflGap) * 1.5); } else { ciChange -= 4 + Math.min(6, (inflGap - prevInflGap) * 1.5); } if (ds.lastGuidance) { if (ds.lastGuidance === 'hawkish' && rateChangeBps < 0) ciChange -= 6; if (ds.lastGuidance === 'dovish' && rateChangeBps > 0) ciChange -= 6; if (ds.lastGuidance === 'hawkish' && rateChangeBps > 0) ciChange += 2; if (ds.lastGuidance === 'dovish' && rateChangeBps < 0) ciChange += 2; if (ds.lastGuidance === d.guidanceTone) ciChange += 1; } if (Math.abs(newInflation - this.INFLATION_TARGET) <= 1.0) ciChange += 5; if (round.hasFiscalPanel) { if (d.fiscalResponse === 'independence') ciChange += 10; if (d.fiscalResponse === 'capitulation') ciChange -= 15; } if (ds.lastRateDirection !== 0 && rateChangeBps !== 0) { if ((ds.lastRateDirection > 0 && rateChangeBps < 0) || (ds.lastRateDirection < 0 && rateChangeBps > 0)) { ciChange -= 8; } } var newCI = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(ds.credibilityIndex + ciChange))); if (round.hasFxPanel && ci < 40) { newCI = Math.max(0, newCI - 20); } ds.policyRate = newRate; ds.inflation = newInflation; ds.gdpGrowth = newGdpGrowth; ds.outputGap = newGap; ds.prevOutputGap = prevGap; ds.exchangeRate = newExchangeRate; ds.exchangeDepreciation = exchangeChange; ds.credibilityIndex = newCI; ds.reserves = newReserves; ds.unemployment = newUnemployment; ds.lastGuidance = d.guidanceTone; ds.lastRateDirection = rateChangeBps; if (d.fiscalResponse === 'capitulation') ds.capitulated = true; ds.inflationHistory.push(newInflation); ds.rateHistory.push(newRate); ds.credibilityHistory.push(newCI); ds.gdpHistory.push(newGdpGrowth); ds.outputGapHistory.push(newGap); ds.exchangeHistory.push(newExchangeRate); ds.reservesHistory.push(newReserves); var ciFillEl = document.getElementById('ciFill'); if (ciFillEl) ciFillEl.style.width = newCI + '%'; var nextPeriod = (state.currentPeriod || 1) + 1; if (nextPeriod <= (state.maxPeriods || this.ROUNDS.length)) { this._updateBriefing({ currentPeriod: nextPeriod }); } return { period: period, rateChange: rateChangeBps, policyRate: newRate, inflation: newInflation, gdpGrowth: newGdpGrowth, outputGap: newGap, credibilityIndex: newCI, exchangeRate: newExchangeRate, reserves: newReserves, unemployment: newUnemployment, guidanceTone: d.guidanceTone }; } setupUI(uiManager) { uiManager.bind('currentDay', 'currentPeriod'); uiManager.bind('maxPeriods', 'maxPeriods'); uiManager.bind('inflationDisplay', 'domainState.inflation', (v) => v.toFixed(1) + '%'); uiManager.bind('gdpDisplay', 'domainState.gdpGrowth', (v) => v.toFixed(1) + '%'); uiManager.bind('rateDisplay', 'domainState.policyRate', (v) => v.toFixed(2) + '%'); uiManager.bind('ciDisplay', 'domainState.credibilityIndex', (v) => Math.round(v) + '/100'); uiManager.bind('exchangeDisplay', 'domainState.exchangeRate', (v) => v.toFixed(2)); uiManager.bind('reservesDisplay', 'domainState.reserves', (v) => v.toFixed(1)); } getChartConfig() { return { inflationChart: { type: 'line', data: { labels: [], datasets: [{ label: 'Inflation (%)', data: [], borderColor: '#e74c3c', backgroundColor: 'rgba(231,76,60,0.1)', borderWidth: 3, fill: true, tension: 0.3 }, { label: 'Policy Rate (%)', data: [], borderColor: '#3498db', backgroundColor: 'rgba(52,152,219,0.05)', borderWidth: 2, fill: false, tension: 0.3, borderDash: [5, 5] }, { label: 'Target (3%)', data: [], borderColor: '#27ae60', backgroundColor: 'transparent', borderWidth: 2, fill: false, pointRadius: 0, borderDash: [10, 5] }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { title: { display: true, text: 'Inflation vs Policy Rate', color: '#8aa8c7' }, legend: { labels: { color: '#8aa8c7' } } }, scales: { x: { ticks: { color: '#6a8aaa' }, grid: { color: 'rgba(100,160,220,0.1)' } }, y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { color: '#6a8aaa' }, grid: { color: 'rgba(100,160,220,0.1)' } } } } }, credibilityChart: { type: 'line', data: { labels: [], datasets: [{ label: 'Credibility Index', data: [], borderColor: '#f39c12', backgroundColor: 'rgba(243,156,18,0.15)', borderWidth: 3, fill: true, tension: 0.3 }, { label: 'Crisis Threshold (40)', data: [], borderColor: '#e74c3c', backgroundColor: 'transparent', borderWidth: 1, fill: false, pointRadius: 0, borderDash: [8, 4] }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { title: { display: true, text: 'Credibility Index', color: '#8aa8c7' }, legend: { labels: { color: '#8aa8c7' } } }, scales: { x: { ticks: { color: '#6a8aaa' }, grid: { color: 'rgba(100,160,220,0.1)' } }, y: { min: 0, max: 100, ticks: { color: '#6a8aaa' }, grid: { color: 'rgba(100,160,220,0.1)' } } } } } }; } getChartData(state) { var ds = state.domainState; var labels = ds.inflationHistory.map(function(_, i) { return 'Q' + (i + 1); }); var targetLine = ds.inflationHistory.map(function() { return 3.0; }); var crisisLine = ds.credibilityHistory.map(function() { return 40; }); return { inflationChart: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: ds.inflationHistory }, { data: ds.rateHistory }, { data: targetLine }] }, credibilityChart: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: ds.credibilityHistory }, { data: crisisLine }] } }; } getPerformanceSummary(history) { if (!history.length) return {}; var inflations = history.map(function(r) { return r.results ? r.results.inflation : 0; }); var gaps = history.map(function(r) { return r.results ? Math.abs(r.results.outputGap) : 0; }); var lastCI = history[history.length - 1].results ? history[history.length - 1].results.credibilityIndex : 50; var lastInflation = inflations[inflations.length - 1]; var quartersOnTarget = inflations.filter(function(inf) { return Math.abs(inf - 3.0) <= 1.0; }).length; var avgGap = gaps.reduce(function(s, g) { return s + g; }, 0) / gaps.length; var inflScore = quartersOnTarget * (30 / 8); var gapScore = Math.max(0, 25 - avgGap * 10); var ciScore = lastCI * 0.25; var totalScore = Math.round(inflScore + gapScore + ciScore); var bonusPoints = 0; if (quartersOnTarget >= 5) bonusPoints += 5; if (lastCI > 70) bonusPoints += 3; totalScore += bonusPoints; var performance = 'Needs Improvement'; if (totalScore >= 70) performance = 'Excellent — Master Central Banker'; else if (totalScore >= 55) performance = 'Good — Competent Governor'; else if (totalScore >= 40) performance = 'Fair — Learning the Ropes'; var insights = []; if (lastInflation <= 4.0 && lastInflation >= 2.0) { insights.push('Inflation successfully brought within the target band — strong disinflation strategy.'); } else if (lastInflation > 5.0) { insights.push('Inflation remains well above target. The tightening cycle was insufficient or credibility was eroded.'); } if (lastCI > 70) { insights.push('High credibility achieved — your communication was consistent with your actions.'); } else if (lastCI < 40) { insights.push('Credibility fell below the crisis threshold. Inconsistent signaling or political capitulation destroyed market trust.'); } if (avgGap > 1.5) { insights.push('Output volatility was high. Consider a more gradual approach to rate changes.'); } return { totalScore: totalScore, performance: performance, finalInflation: lastInflation, finalCredibility: lastCI, quartersOnTarget: quartersOnTarget, avgOutputGapVolatility: Math.round(avgGap * 10) / 10, bonusPoints: bonusPoints, insights: insights }; } getHint(state, results) { if (!results) return null; if (results.inflation > 5.0 && results.credibilityIndex < 50) { return window.mySimulation.t('hint_crisis_risk'); } if (results.inflation > state.domainState.inflation) { return window.mySimulation.t('hint_inflation_rising'); } if (results.outputGap < -1.0) { return window.mySimulation.t('hint_recession'); } if (results.credibilityIndex < 40) { return window.mySimulation.t('hint_low_credibility'); } if (Math.abs(results.inflation - 3.0) <= 1.0 && results.credibilityIndex > 60) { return window.mySimulation.t('hint_on_track'); } return null; } getHistoryTableConfig() { return [ { key: 'results.policyRate', label: 'Rate (%)', i18nKey: 'col_rate', formatter: function(v) { return v.toFixed(2) + '%'; } }, { key: 'results.rateChange', label: 'Change (bps)', i18nKey: 'col_change', formatter: function(v) { return (v > 0 ? '+' : '') + v; } }, { key: 'results.guidanceTone', label: 'Guidance', i18nKey: 'col_guidance' }, { key: 'results.inflation', label: 'Inflation', i18nKey: 'col_inflation', formatter: function(v) { return v.toFixed(1) + '%'; } }, { key: 'results.gdpGrowth', label: 'GDP Growth', i18nKey: 'col_gdp', formatter: function(v) { return v.toFixed(1) + '%'; } }, { key: 'results.outputGap', label: 'Output Gap', i18nKey: 'col_gap', formatter: function(v) { return (v > 0 ? '+' : '') + v.toFixed(1) + '%'; } }, { key: 'results.credibilityIndex', label: 'CI', i18nKey: 'col_ci' }, { key: 'results.exchangeRate', label: 'QZQ/USD', i18nKey: 'col_fx', formatter: function(v) { return v.toFixed(2); } } ]; } getPresets() { return null; } getTranslations() { return { en: { title: `Banco Central: The Governor Dilemma`, subtitle: `Banco Central de Quisqueda — Monetary Policy Committee`, period_label: `Quarter`, period_of: `of`, inflation_label: `Inflation (YoY)`, inflation_target: `Target: 3.0% ± 1.0%`, gdp_label: `GDP Growth`, gdp_potential: `Potential: 2.0%`, rate_label: `Policy Rate`, ci_label: `Credibility Index`, exchange_label: `QZQ / USD`, reserves_label: `Reserves (USD B)`, briefing_heading: `Economic Briefing`, decisions_heading: `MPC Decisions`, rate_change_label: `Policy Rate Change (bps)`, guidance_label: `Forward Guidance Tone`, shock_heading: `Commodity Shock Response`, fx_heading: `Currency Under Pressure — FX Intervention`, fiscal_heading: `Government Pressure Event`, submit_btn: `Submit Quarter`, undo_btn: `Undo Last Quarter`, history_heading: `Policy History`, col_rate: `Rate (%)`, col_change: `Change (bps)`, col_guidance: `Guidance`, col_inflation: `Inflation`, col_gdp: `GDP Growth`, col_gap: `Output Gap`, col_ci: `CI`, col_fx: `QZQ/USD`, briefing_r1: `Inflation stands at 6.8% against a 3.0% target.
